gloam.name: Gloam pursuit
gloam.description: A precise pursuit. An exposed target takes 12 extra damage in addition to the normal exposure bonus; a successful hit consumes exposure.

aegis.name: Oathguard
aegis.description: Grant a living ally guard: 45% incoming damage reduction until their next activation. Also cleanse burn. Can target the caster.

raincall.name: Rain of glass
raincall.description: A cross-shaped magical shower. Successful hits soak enemies for three activations, preparing lightning synergy. Allies and terrain are unchanged.

delay.name: Stolen hour
delay.description: Deal spirit damage and delay a surviving enemy by 30 timeline ticks on a successful hit. Does not apply the slow status.

strike.name: Weapon strike
strike.description: A precise weapon attack. Height and flanking increase damage.

cleave.name: Sundering arc
cleave.description: Strike a cross of tiles. Allies in the arc are spared.

ember.name: Cinder bloom
ember.description: An explosive cross of flame. Burns targets for two turns and ignites grass.

mend.name: Thread of life
mend.description: Restore 36 health to an ally, or revive a fallen ally with 24 health.

surge.name: Glasslight bolt
surge.description: A lightning bolt. Deals 50% more damage to soaked targets.

frost.name: Stillwater
frost.description: Chill enemies and freeze water into traversable ice. Slows for two turns.

veil.name: Dusk needle
veil.description: A ranged blade that exposes the target to follow-up attacks.

haste.name: Borrowed dawn
haste.description: Advance an ally’s next turn by 35 timeline ticks.

rally.name: Lantern concord
rally.description: Spend 3 momentum for a coordinated burst. Allies are spared.

custom-ashfall.name: Ashfall
custom-ashfall.description: A lighter cross of fire. Burns enemies and ignites grass; water remains a safer approach. Trades damage for a lower energy cost.

custom-hearthguard.name: Hearthguard
custom-hearthguard.description: Guard one nearby ally and cleanse burn until their next activation. Cheaper than Oathguard, with shorter reach.

custom-cinderstep.name: Cinderstep
custom-cinderstep.description: Advance one ally by 35 timeline ticks. Costs one less energy than Borrowed dawn; does not grant a lasting speed status.

custom-kindlethread.name: Kindlethread
custom-kindlethread.description: Restore an ally or revive a fallen companion using the existing healing rule. Lower cost, power and reach than Thread of life.

custom-glass-shot.name: Glass shot
custom-glass-shot.description: A physical bow shot. Trades energy and lower power for four-tile reach; does not add a new projectile collision rule.

custom-shard-volley.name: Shard volley
custom-shard-volley.description: A cross-shaped physical volley. Spares allies, with lower power than a close Sundering arc.

custom-facet-mark.name: Facet mark
custom-facet-mark.description: A spirit shot that exposes an enemy for two activations on a successful hit. Uses Dusk needle's existing exposure rule.

custom-cinder-hymn.name: Cinder hymn
custom-cinder-hymn.description: A cross of flame. Burns enemies and ignites grass; lower power and cost than Cinder bloom.

custom-ashen-shelter.name: Ashen shelter
custom-ashen-shelter.description: Protect one living ally with guard and cleanse burn. This is an immediate rite, not a sustained chant.

custom-mourning-bell.name: Mourning bell
custom-mourning-bell.description: Spirit damage and a 30-tick delay to a surviving enemy on a successful hit. Does not silence or interrupt.

custom-rimeward.name: Rimeward
custom-rimeward.description: Shield one living ally with guard and cleanse burn. Short-range protection, not ice immunity.

custom-frostline.name: Frostline
custom-frostline.description: Freeze a cross of water into traversable ice and slow enemies for two activations. Lower reach than Stillwater.

custom-winters-mercy.name: Winter's mercy
custom-winters-mercy.description: Heal a nearby ally and cleanse burn, or revive at the existing fixed 24 health. Close support rather than long-range recovery.

custom-sunlit-pursuit.name: Sunlit pursuit
custom-sunlit-pursuit.description: Physical pursuit that consumes exposure on a successful hit. An exposed target takes the existing twelve-point pursuit bonus.

custom-dawn-cut.name: Dawn cut
custom-dawn-cut.description: A close cross-shaped saber attack. Allies are spared; costs the same energy as Sundering arc with lower power.

custom-daybreak-feint.name: Daybreak feint
custom-daybreak-feint.description: Spirit damage that exposes an enemy for two activations on a hit. Shorter reach and lower cost than Dusk needle.

custom-briar-shelter.name: Briar shelter
custom-briar-shelter.description: Guard one nearby living ally and cleanse burn until their next activation. The thorns do not retaliate or root enemies.

custom-dewfall.name: Dewfall
custom-dewfall.description: A cross of spirit rain. Successful hits soak enemies for three activations, preparing lightning; allies and terrain remain unchanged.

custom-green-mending.name: Green mending
custom-green-mending.description: Restore health and cleanse burn, or revive a fallen ally at the existing fixed 24 health. No regeneration status is added.

custom-anvil-peal.name: Anvil peal
custom-anvil-peal.description: A single-target lightning strike. A soaked enemy takes the existing 1.5 damage multiplier; there is no stun or chain lightning.

custom-dissonant-strike.name: Dissonant strike
custom-dissonant-strike.description: Spirit damage that delays a surviving enemy by 30 timeline ticks on a successful hit. Does not silence or interrupt.

custom-tempered-tempo.name: Tempered tempo
custom-tempered-tempo.description: Advance one nearby ally by 35 timeline ticks. This is immediate timeline support, not a lasting speed bonus.

crownseal.name: Bellkeeper’s seal
crownseal.description: Awarded once for clearing The silent belfry. A broken oath still carries power.

ironblade.name: Oathsteel blade
ironblade.description: A reliable edge for the company's front line.

twinsteel.name: Ashen twinblades
twinsteel.description: Light paired blades reward quick footwork.

cedarrod.name: Glass-tipped rod
cedarrod.description: A shard of river glass focuses elemental spells.

willowstaff.name: Living willow staff
willowstaff.description: A living branch lends resilience to its bearer.

leather.name: Company leathers
leather.description: Flexible protection without a movement penalty.

lamellar.name: Bronze lamellar
lamellar.description: Strong protection at the cost of one movement.

wayboots.name: Wayfarer's boots
wayboots.description: Reach one tile farther on every activation.

copperfocus.name: Copper focus
copperfocus.description: A modest rune amplifies damaging magic.

watchcharm.name: Dawnwatch charm
watchcharm.description: An old watch charm grants quicker activations.

custom-coalbrand.name: Coalbrand
custom-coalbrand.description: A furnace-tempered blade for an Emberwarden or Runewarden. Balanced physical and magical pressure.

custom-kilncoat.name: Kilncoat
custom-kilncoat.description: A padded workshop coat. Adds health and armor; grants no fire immunity.

custom-emberglass.name: Emberglass lens
custom-emberglass.description: A soot-dark lens that focuses magic without slowing the bearer.

custom-ashrunner-blades.name: Ashrunner blades
custom-ashrunner-blades.description: Light blades for the company's flanker.

custom-weir-token.name: Weirkeeper's token
custom-weir-token.description: First-clear keepsake from the Ashen Weir. A defensive relic, with no scripted interaction.

custom-archive-lantern.name: Archive lantern
custom-archive-lantern.description: First-clear keepsake from the Cinder Archive. Its light carries no new targeting rule.

custom-glass-bow.name: Wayfarer's glass bow
custom-glass-bow.description: Lantern envoys equipment. Editable class proficiency and bonuses; no additional weapon mechanic.

custom-cantor-lantern.name: Ashwood lantern staff
custom-cantor-lantern.description: Lantern envoys equipment. Editable class proficiency and bonuses; no additional weapon mechanic.

custom-rime-spear.name: Rimeglass spear
custom-rime-spear.description: A short spear for Frost Sentinels. Its name grants no additional attack range.

custom-dawn-saber.name: Dawnsteel saber
custom-dawn-saber.description: A balanced saber for Dawn Duelists. Existing class and exposure rules determine its strikes.

custom-vigil-compass.name: Vigil compass
custom-vigil-compass.description: First-clear relic of the Frostglass Vigil. Keeps the company moving through winter roads.

custom-rimeplate.name: Rimeplate
custom-rimeplate.description: Frost Sentinel plate. More protection at the cost of one movement; grants no ice immunity.

custom-thornwood-staff.name: Thornwood staff-spear
custom-thornwood-staff.description: A Thorn Warden focus and walking spear. Weapon strikes retain their normal one-tile reach.

custom-resonant-hammer.name: Resonant forgehammer
custom-resonant-hammer.description: A Resonant Smith focus. Its visual ringing adds no extra damage or area to an ability.

custom-briarcoat.name: Briarcoat
custom-briarcoat.description: Leather and bronze scales. Adds protection; grants no nature resistance or retaliation.

custom-forge-apron.name: Forge apron
custom-forge-apron.description: A reinforced leather apron. Grants no fire immunity or crafting capability.

custom-resonance-seal.name: Resonance seal
custom-resonance-seal.description: First-clear relic of the Briar Resonance. Existing equipment bonuses only.

shrine.name: The shrine of Veyr
shrine.subtitle: Contract I · The broken promise
shrine.description: Secure the first shard from an Oathless patrol. The causeway offers the safest crossing; ice can open another route.

causeway.name: The drowned causeway
causeway.subtitle: Contract II · A road beneath water
causeway.description: The retreating patrol has flooded the lower crossing. Two mobile outriders screen an elemental caster and a healer across the stream.

redoubt.name: The Briar Resonance
redoubt.subtitle: The living road / The silent forge
redoubt.description: Rowan and Edrin join Nera and Joren at a foundry claimed by the watch. Defeat all six defenders. Soaking prepares lightning, while guards and healing protect either formation.
redoubt.objective: Defeat Senna, Garron and all four watch defenders

bellkeeper.name: The silent belfry
bellkeeper.subtitle: Contract IV · The last bell
bellkeeper.description: Orren, the Bellkeeper, guards the crown seal in a raised courtyard. At half health he breaks his oath: cleansing burn and slow, restoring energy, gaining speed and advancing his next turn. Defeat him and his three retainers.

shrine.speaker: narrator
shrine.text: Secure the first shard from an Oathless patrol. The causeway offers the safest crossing; ice can open another route.

shrine.speaker: sera
shrine.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.

causeway.speaker: narrator
causeway.text: The retreating patrol has flooded the lower crossing. Two mobile outriders screen an elemental caster and a healer across the stream.

causeway.speaker: sera
causeway.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.

redoubt.speaker: narrator
redoubt.text: Briar roots have split the old foundry road. Across the dew pools, the watch rings a stolen forge bell.

redoubt.speaker: sera
redoubt.text: I am Rowan Briar. Dewfall can soak their formation; Edrin, let your lightning follow. I can shelter our lead fighter.

redoubt.speaker: ilya
redoubt.text: That bell was my teacher's. Anvil peal strikes harder against soaked armor. Keep me close enough to answer.

redoubt.speaker: enemy-ember-scholar-ashen-weir
redoubt.text: Roads need wardens, Rowan. I will shelter this watch as firmly as you shelter your friends.

redoubt.speaker: enemy-cinder-clock-ashen-weir
redoubt.text: The forge belongs to whoever keeps it ringing. Your rain will conduct my answer just as well.

redoubt.speaker: mae
redoubt.text: The central stone road is open. We can cross the pools with Frostline, but we still have to defeat every defender.

redoubt.speaker: corin
redoubt.text: Then we move together. Guard the approach, turn their timing, and leave an opening for my saber.

bellkeeper.speaker: narrator
bellkeeper.text: Orren, the Bellkeeper, guards the crown seal in a raised courtyard. At half health he breaks his oath: cleansing burn and slow, restoring energy, gaining speed and advancing his next turn. Defeat him and his three retainers.

bellkeeper.speaker: sera
bellkeeper.text: A crown is only a promise. Let’s see who it was made to.
